scenes.setting: Beef stewing under a Magician's flame while the Faceless rule takes shape: in the window's reflection he lets the face become Zhou Mingrui's again — 'Long time no see…' — and understands that you may wear anyone, but you remain yourself
scenes.text_anchor: This was Zhou Mingrui from Earth.

scenes.setting: Jurgen at the door in the drizzle: he is taking his grandmother (and a caged Brody) south on Monday, and leaves a colleague's card for bail and disputes. Afterwards the house is silent enough to hear distant carriages. 'The new year…'

The dead city in the darkness — a whole civilization's grave — and on its central platform the half-collapsed temple; then every lantern dies at once, a child's voice begs 'Save me…' beside Derrick's ear, and only the Demon Hunter's igniting dust keeps the team whole
